description: Write a structured handoff document before a session ends, before a context-heavy interruption (SSH/tmux disconnect, context running low, a worktree being handed to another worker or agent), or when explicitly asked for a handoff — captures progress, what worked/failed, and the exact next step so a fresh session can resume without re-deriving context. Own version of the dx plugin's `/dx:handoff`.
